entities.summary: György Fehér was a Hungarian film director and screenwriter. His film Szenvedély was screened in the Un Certain Regard section at the 1998 Cannes Film Festival. He was also a producer on Béla Tarr's seven-hour film Sátántangó.

entities.summary: György Fehér was a Hungarian film director and screenwriter. His film Szenvedély was screened in the Un Certain Regard section at the 1998 Cannes Film Festival. He was also a producer on Béla Tarr's seven-hour film Sátántangó.
